output.title: botsmith: AI Chatbot with Source Citations
output.tagline: Every answer cites its source or escalates to a human.
output.description_short: Build a support chatbot from your docs in minutes. Answers always cite sources or escalate — never hallucinate.
output.description_long:
botsmith creates a reliable AI support chatbot from your documentation, helpdesk articles, and past tickets — in about five minutes from a sitemap URL. Unlike generic chatbots, botsmith enforces a strict guardrail: every answer must cite a source passage. When confidence is low, it refuses to guess and escalates to a human instead of hallucinating.

Trusted by support teams at SaaS companies with 100+ docs and rising ticket volume, botsmith resolves up to 61% of inbound chats end-to-end — all while maintaining 100% source citation accuracy. The result? Faster deflection without eroding customer trust.

Embed as a widget or integrate with your existing helpdesk. No training UI to babysit. No coding required.

**Key Benefits:**
- Answers either cite sources or escalate — never invent
- 5-minute setup from a sitemap URL
- Proven 61% deflection rate at real customers like Pixelhaven
- Built for teams tired of bots that confidently get things wrong
screenshot_order: 1st: Chat widget showing a customer question with cited source links — demonstrates core trust feature
2nd: Setup screen with sitemap URL input and 'Launch in 5 minutes' timer — highlights speed and ease
3rd: Dashboard showing 61% deflection rate and escalation log — proves impact and safety

faq.a: It requires every answer to cite a source passage. If confidence is low, it escalates to a human instead of guessing.
Median time from sitemap URL to first answer is 5 minutes. No training interface to manage.

faq.q: Can I embed this in my existing helpdesk?
faq.a: Yes. botsmith embeds as a widget or integrates directly with most helpdesk platforms.

faq.q: What happens when the bot doesn’t know?
faq.a: It won’t improvise. Instead, it flags low-confidence queries and escalates to your support team.
We process your docs securely and don’t train on your data. Enterprise security details available on request.
